title: The question — is it an app, or a skill?
text: Someone might ask how the buyer list app finds buyers on its own. It's not an app, it's a skill, a folder of instructions Claude reads first. So, how does the buyer list skill find buyers?

title: Anatomy — a skill is a folder
text: A skill is a folder Claude reads before it works. This one is buyer list, the skill. MD contains the full instruction set, plain language, no hidden logic. Claude reads it then acts. The file is the program.

title: Pipeline — read, execute, return
text: The pipeline is in the step section. Claude reads each step in order and executes it. Linear, no branching unless the step says so.

title: Mechanism — what the page says, exactly
text: Buyer list is a specification written as an instruction set.
